request.style: English, soulful female jazz vocal, upright piano, upright bass, brushed drums, muted trumpet, warm and pleading mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Awake Lord why do you sleep
Rouse yourself from your rest
Do not reject us forever
Keep us in your sight

[Verse]
Why hide your face away
Forget our deep distress
Our soul is sunk to dust
Our body clings to ground

[Chorus]
Rise up and help us now
Redeem us in your love
Steadfast kindness holds us fast
When all our strength is gone

[Chorus]
Rise up and help us now
Redeem us in your love
Steadfast kindness holds us fast
When all our strength is gone

[Outro]
Rise up and help us
Redeem us for your love
